data.name: The Electric Bots
data.detailed_description:
The Electric Bots is a fast-paced robot fighting game set in a gritty post-cyberpunk era. Once built to serve humanity, a class of obsolete robots now faces total annihilation. Locked away in a high-security prison, a brutal tournament is created — one last chance for survival. The only way out is through victory.

Fight through intense robotic battles, where each robot has a unique combat style, and dominate the prison arenas as you battle for your right to exist.

Players take control of powerful robots in intense close-range combat using spears and special abilities to destroy their opponents. Electric Bots features both Story Mode and Quick Game Mode:

* In Story Mode, players can manually select and play through the stories of three unique robots, each fighting for freedom and identity.

* In Quick Game Mode, players can jump into fast-paced matches with several pre-selected bots.

Progression is achieved through victory — every round pushes you closer to ultimate survival. It is perma-death, either you complete it or you lose it - this demands focus, skill, and determination.

* ⚙️ Play as multiple combat-ready robots, each with unique fighting abilities and special attacks.

* ⚔️ Spear-based melee combat with dynamic hit reactions and satisfying impact.

* 🏆 Story, Quick Game, and Training Modes — Experience the full story of three robots. Fight instantly in quick matches. Train your skills to prepare for the ultimate fights.

* 🤖 Drone Mode — take control of a combat drone equipped with a chemical sprayer that releases intensified gas capable of damaging and eliminating enemy bots.

* 🔁 Replayable Modes — even after completion, players can replay storylines or matches without restriction.

* 🔥 Gritty Futuristic Prison Arenas — every arena delivers a different atmosphere, danger, and visual tone.

* 🎶 Immersive Sound and Music Design — built to amplify every strike and explosion.

* 💀 Survival-Driven Narrative — fight, win, or face permanent destruction.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 (4–6 cores)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 (6 cores 12 threads)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 (12 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
